snippet.title: Echo Pandemic: Gameplay Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Echo Pandemic — Official Gameplay Trailer
A stealth game where you are a single bat carrying a disease the aliens cannot survive. Slip through occupied towns by echolocation, bite one host, and disappear before the patrols arrive. The outbreak does the rest.
🦇 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4750700/Echo_Pandemic/
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
About the game
Earth has been invaded. Earth has antibodies. You are one of them.
Roost is a hand-drawn stealth game played from inside the senses of a bat. The world is rendered in ink and pencil — a sketchbook that fills in around you as your chirps reach it, and falls away to outlines when they don't. Color exists only when you scan for infection. Every visual is information.
Each night, you enter an occupied town. You find a host. You bite. You vanish. The disease moves through the town on its own — through gatherings, contact, contamination — and you return to a town that has changed in your absence.
Features
• Stealth gameplay built around real echolocation — sound is how you see and how you're heard
• A hand-drawn black-and-white visual system where color means infection
• An outbreak simulation that runs between missions
• Strain authoring: design diseases that trade lethality for spread, delay symptoms, outpace alien vaccines
• A town that remembers — return to find quarantine tape, medical tents, and a changed enemy
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎨 Devlog & updates: https://echo-pandemic.netlify.app/
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
